full_judgment: Mainur Reza Chowdhury J: The leave petitioner has filed this petition against judgment of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 362 of 1988 (Comilla) Civil Revision No. 8729 of 1991(Dhaka) discharging the Rule and affirming the judgment and decree passed by the learned Subordinate Judge, Chandpur in Title Appeal No. 64 of 1984, dismissing the appeal thereby affirming the judgment and decree passed by the learned Munsif, Matlab in Title Suit No. 744 of 1984 decreeing the suit.
